### Cookie Counter

![445](../../../images/usage-1792771515804.webp)

- A multi-function counter that displays the numbers you care about during a stream.
- Besides the likes and concurrent viewers you care about in a live stream, it also counts chat comments and the number of users who commented.
	- It tracks 7 values: first-time viewers, number of users, likes, concurrent viewers, comment count, gift amount (stream total), and follower count.
- You can also specify "specific words" in chat, and it will count those too.
